vulnerability.name: USN-8206-1
vulnerability.description: Antonio Morales Maldonado discovered that OpenMPT did not properly limit the length of strings in certain cases, leading to a buffer overflow. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause OpenMPT to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

statements.status_notes: OpenMPT could be made to crash if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
